translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
haath abu-lahab kay barbad hon , aur woh khud barbad hochuka hai ,
uss ki dolat aur uss ney jo kamai ki thi , woh uss kay kuch kaam nahi aai .
woh bharaktay sholon wali aag mein dakhil hoga ,
aur uss ki biwi bhi ,   lakriyan dhoti hoi ,
apni gardan mein moonjh ki rassi liye huye .
